title: Going back to List uses List's sort, a manual order never changes it
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. In List, sort by a column (e.g. Created on) so a non-default sort is saved.
custom_steps:
1. Set and confirm a List sort.
  2. Switch to Tech View, then Board View.
  3. Switch back to List.
  4. Observe the sort order.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Switching back to List uses the List sort the user last chose there (e.g. by Created date).
  • The manual order set in Tech View or Board View never changes the List sort.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10044 — Switch between display options. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options”, PRD v33 (2026-09-28), requirement(s) S1-R7 (read 30 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R7: “When the user switches back to List, it uses the List sort they last chose there (for example, by Created date). The manual order from Tech View and Board View never changes the List sort (S9-R13).”
